references.text: The Kenites are mentioned as one of the peoples in the land of Canaan that God promised to Abraham.
Moses' father-in-law Jethro was a priest in Midian and belonged to the Kenites, which shows the Kenites' connection to Israel.
The Kenites, descendants of Moses' father-in-law, went up from the City of Palms together with the people of Judah.
Heber the Kenite had separated himself from the other Kenites and pitched his tent near Saannaim.
Saul warned the Kenites before he attacked the Amalekites, pointing to their kindness toward Israel.
Obadiah prophesies against Edom, who lived in the clefts of the rock and felt secure, paralleling the image of a nest in the rock.
